name: Compute Cluster S42: Timestamp Comparisons
description: Tests: Timestamp(value=) for date comparisons, date-only vs datetime+timezone, windowed filtering with index() >= start and index() <= end.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S42: Timestamp Comparisons
# Tests: Timestamp type for date filtering, timezone, windowed ranges
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)

# === DATE COMPARISON: Timestamp(value=) required ===
cutoff = Timestamp(value="2023-04-01")
is_after = index() >= cutoff

# === DATE WINDOW: start/end range ===
start = Timestamp(value="2023-04-01")
end = Timestamp(value="2023-09-30")
in_window = index() >= start and index() <= end

# === TIMEZONE-AWARE TIMESTAMP ===
ny_cutoff = Timestamp(value="2023-06-15 09:30:00", timezone="America/New_York")
is_after_ny = index() >= ny_cutoff

# === FILTER RETURNS BY DATE WINDOW ===
window_ret = where(in_window, ret)
post_cutoff_ret = where(is_after, ret)

# === WHERE 3-ARG: fill with default instead of NaN ===
window_ret_filled = where(in_window, ret, 0.0)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return (post-cutoff vs full)',
    category='Timestamp',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Post-Cutoff', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Full Period', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cumulative(post_cutoff_ret, agg=AggregationType.Sum), cumulative(ret, agg=AggregationType.Sum)))

cards(
    category='Timestamp',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Date Window Stats (Apr-Sep 2023)', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='where(cond, ret) Mean', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='where(cond, ret, 0) Mean', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Observation Count', card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
    ])
)((window_ret, window_ret_filled, window_ret))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Post-Cutoff Days'
    )
)((post_cutoff_ret, is_after))
